sql: SELECT json_build_object('por_origem', (SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT i.unit, i.provider, coalesce(m.metadata->>'source','(sem source)') AS src, m.status, count(*) AS n FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id JOIN wapi_instances i ON i.id = c.instance_id WHERE i.company_id = (SELECT company_id FROM wapi_instances WHERE unit = 'Planeta Divertido' LIMIT 1) AND m.from_me AND m.timestamp > now() - interval '14 days' AND m.timestamp < now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,3,4) t), 'contatos', (SELECT json_agg(u ORDER BY u.contact_phone, u.timestamp) FROM (SELECT c.contact_phone, c.remote_jid, i.unit, m.timestamp, m.status, m.message_id, m.metadata->>'source' AS src, left(m.content, 40) AS txt FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id JOIN wapi_instances i ON i.id = c.instance_id WHERE (c.contact_phone LIKE '%1194153%' OR c.contact_phone LIKE '%1197976%') AND m.timestamp > now() - interval '4 days') u)) AS r
